contract: on primary recovery exit, TERM the verified VOC-only process group; after 15 seconds KILL the group if the CLI remains
new_monitor_command:
bash -c 
  set -u
  primary=$1; worker=$2; pgid=$3
  while kill -0 $primary 2>/dev/null && kill -0 $worker 2>/dev/null; do sleep 30; done
  if ! kill -0 $primary 2>/dev/null && kill -0 $worker 2>/dev/null; then
    echo $(date --iso-8601=seconds) primary recovery exited; terminating verified VOC process group pgid=$pgid
    kill -TERM -- -$pgid 2>/dev/null || true
    sleep 15
    if kill -0 $worker 2>/dev/null; then
      echo $(date --iso-8601=seconds) VOC process group survived TERM; escalating KILL pgid=$pgid
      kill -KILL -- -$pgid 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
